    <div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 8pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">W. R. GRACE&#160;&amp; CO.</div>

    <div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 8pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">CURRENT REPORT</div>

    <div style="text-align: left; margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 8pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-weight: bold;">Item 5.03.</span><span style="display: inline-block; text-indent: 0px; font-size: 1px; width: 72pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-weight: bold;"> Amendments to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Change in Fiscal Year.</span></div>

    <div style="text-align: left; margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 8pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The information set forth in Item 8.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K is incorporated by reference herein.</div>

    <div style="text-align: left; margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 8pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-weight: bold;">Item 8.01.</span><span style="display: inline-block; text-indent: 0px; font-size: 1px; width: 72pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-weight: bold;">Other Events.</span></div>

    <div style="text-align: left; margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 8pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">On April 14, 2021, W. R. Grace &amp; Co. (&#8220;Grace&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) entered into an amendment (the &#8220;Amendment&#8221;) to a
      certain letter agreement, dated February 1, 2021, by and among Grace, 40 North Management LLC<span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;">, 40 North GP III LLC, 40 North Latitude Master Fund Ltd</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;">.</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;">&#160;and 40 North Latitude Fund LP (collectively, &#8220;40 North&#8221;)</span>.&#160; Pursuant to the
      Amendment, Grace and 40 North agreed to extend the nomination deadline for 40 North to submit candidates for election to the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors at the Company&#8217;s 2021 Annual Meeting of Shareholders to April 26, 2021.&#160; Grace and 40 North also
      agreed not to make any further public statements regarding the other party or the ongoing discussions between the parties prior to April 26, 2021.</div>

    <div style="text-align: left; margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 8pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">A copy of the press release announcing the entry of Grace and 40 North into the Amendment is attached hereto as Exhibit
      99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.</div>

      Exhibits</div>

    <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" id="zb7c3825d694e43cdab7950198dccca7d" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;">

    <td style="width: 9.35%; vertical-align: bottom; border-bottom: #000000 2px solid;" colspan="2">

    <div style="text-align: center; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">GRACE AND 40 NORTH AGREE TO EXTENSION OF DIRECTOR NOMINATION DEADLINE</div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-weight: bold;">COLUMBIA, Md. and NEW YORK, April 14, 2021 &#8211; </font>W. R.
      Grace &amp; Co. (NYSE: GRA) and 40 North Management LLC (&#8220;40 North&#8221;) today announced that the parties have agreed to extend the nomination deadline for 40 North to submit director candidates for election to Grace&#8217;s Board of Directors at its 2021
      Annual Meeting of Shareholders from April 15, 2021 until April 26, 2021. Grace and 40 North are in ongoing discussions regarding a potential transaction. There can be no assurance that a transaction will result and the parties have agreed not to
      comment further before April 26, 2021.</div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
